title: Round 18 / inventor I: m=4 decomposition test below p^{1/10}
question: With randomised targets R=aP+bQ and base size s=p^{1/5}, index calculus with m=4 beats rho only if deciding whether R is a sum of 4 base points (and finding them) costs T_test < p^{1/10}. Is there any finder (algebraic on S_5 with a structured base, e.g. PKM coset x^d=c, Weil-like descent through x->x^d, resultant towers, or a non-Groebner method) whose measured cost exponent per target is below 1/10 at toy sizes, with linear algebra and total cost accounted?
rationale: Only index-calculus route left open by literature survey and PI derivation.
success_criteria: Exact statements; reproducible evidence; honest negatives.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; no commits.
